Silver Touch Hospitals sees numerous patients who visit us concerned about loud snoring or disturbed sleep. Infrequent snoring need not be alarming, but regular snoring or disturbed sleep can indicate a condition known as sleep apnoea. Not only does it impact your sleep, but it also impacts your overall health if left untreated.

If you are looking for a veteran ENT hospital in Ahmedabad, knowing what the experts do when they tackle such issues can assist you in your next move towards improved sleep and health.

What Causes Snoring and Sleep Apnoea?

Snoring typically occurs when the passage of air through the nose and throat is partly obstructed. During sleep apnoea, the airway is entirely blocked for short periods, resulting in cessation of breathing. Nasal congestion, enlarged tonsils, overweight, smoking, or a crooked septum are all factors that can play a part.

Why Snoring Shouldn’t Be Ignored

Most people believe snoring is only a nuisance to their partner, yet it can be an indication of a more serious condition. Sleep apnoea decreases the flow of oxygen to the brain and body. This can, over time, cause high blood pressure, daytime drowsiness, heart complications, and loss of concentration.

How ENT Specialists Diagnose the Problem

ENT doctors at Silver Touch Hospitals start with a comprehensive examination, which can involve a look at the nose, throat, and airway. For some patients, a sleep study may be prescribed to monitor breathing habits when resting. Determining the precise cause of the blockage is the initial step toward successful treatment.

Treatment Options Available

Depending on the cause and severity, treatment can involve surgery, medical devices, or lifestyle changes. For minor cases, positional therapy, weight management, or nasal sprays can offer relief. For physical issues such as oversized tonsils or a crooked septum, surgery can improve breathing considerably and even minimise snoring.
